title: Witch in Stormy Vortex
description: A dramatic fantasy scene shows a central witch with long white hair floating inside a massive swirling waterspout. She holds a red and white polka-dot umbrella as lightning cracks across a dark, colorful sky filled with flying red spider-like creatures, while other witches on broomsticks and sailing ships are caught in the turbulent ocean below.
prompt: A powerful witch with long flowing white hair and a black dress floats midair inside a massive swirling blue waterspout tornado over a stormy ocean, holding a red and white polka dot umbrella, dramatic lightning strikes across a dark sky with pink and purple clouds, red spider-like creatures swirl in the vortex, other witches fly on broomsticks below, tall sailing ships tossed in rough waves, highly detailed fantasy scene
